name: Aino
title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

passives.name: Modular Efficiency Protocol
passives.descriptionRaw:
Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: The <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> over a larger area of effect.
passives.description:
Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler** is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect.

passives.name: Structured Power Booster
passives.descriptionRaw: Aino's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 50% of her Elemental Mastery.
passives.description: Aino's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 50% of her Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Force Limit Analysis
passives.descriptionRaw: When Aino is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.description: When Aino is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

passives.name: Miniaturized Detection Sensor
passives.descriptionRaw:
Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Nod-Krai</color> on the mini-map.
Additionally, Aino appears to be able to alter the Cool Your Jets Ducky's appearance in some way...

combatTalents.name: Bish-Bash-Bosh Repair
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

combatTalents.name: Musecatcher
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
Aino throws a <color=#FFD780FF>Musecatcher</color> forward, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and dragging her along behind it. When the dragging stops, Aino deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to nearby opponents.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the Musecatcher's throwing direction.

combatTalents.name: Precision Hydronic Cooler
combatTalents.descriptionRaw:
Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> to establish a <color=#FFD780FF>Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone</color>.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.
combatTalents.description:
Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the Cool Your Jets Ducky to establish a Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG.

constellations.name: The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium
constellations.descriptionRaw:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> or her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.
constellations.description:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** or her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler**, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

constellations.name: The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials
constellations.descriptionRaw: If Aino is off-field while the <color=#FFD780FF>Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone</color> of her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
constellations.description: If Aino is off-field while the Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone of her Elemental Burst **Precision Hydronic Cooler** is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing AoE Hydro DMG equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair
constellations.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Precision Hydronic Cooler** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply
constellations.descriptionRaw: When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.
constellations.description: When the Elemental Skill **Musecatcher** hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.

Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Burden of Creative Genius
constellations.descriptionRaw:
For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%.
